description: This file defines a utility function 'shapeStackedSeries' that processes raw cost aggregate records into a format suitable for visualization with Recharts, including zero-filling for missing data points. It handles categorization and sorting options, and outputs a structured dataset along with category and service labels.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a Recharts-compatible dataset with zero-filled stacks, supporting categorization and sorting options.
